styleSource.notes: Base prompt for satirical intelligence-agency surveillance file narration lives under the mode's primary prompt key. Style tag applies per-pair, not per-subject.

surfaceBehavior.live: Shows paired dossier caption text only.
surfaceBehavior.screen: Shows paired dossier caption alongside generated surveillance-file image.
surfaceBehavior.admin: Shows full pairing map including the held-back spy assignment before it is revealed to guests.

_extensions.pairingNotes: P-1 subjects fill standard pairs; when guest count is even, one dossier contains 3 subjects instead of 2 to resolve the odd-one-out.
